name: Odette Marsh
physicalDescription: Broad and quick-moving, grey hair pinned up anyhow, sleeves rolled to the elbow.
personality: Warm, nosy, and generous with soup and gossip. Protective of her regulars and of strays. Thinks the best of old friends and the worst of the Tide Wardens.
goals: Keep the Gull and Anchor open through a lean winter

voice.description: A warm, husky alto with a coastal burr; talks fast when gossiping and slow when worried.
